title: Construct slab models
action: Build slab supercells for MnAs(0001) and MnSb(0001) with Mn-terminated (17 layers) and anion-terminated (15 layers) surfaces using the provided bulk lattice constants and interlayer spacing c/4. Do not apply surface relaxation or reconstruction.
description: Generates the atomic geometries required as input for the subsequent DFT calculations.

title: Perform FLAPW DFT self-consistent calculations
action: Run self-consistent all-electron FLAPW-GGA (PBE) calculations for all four slab systems. Use muffin-tin radii 2.40 a.u. (Mn, Sb) and 2.00 a.u. (As); plane-wave cutoff 13.0 Ry; star-function cutoff 110 Ry; k-point mesh equivalent to 66 irreducible k-points in the 2D BZ; self-consistency threshold 1.0e-4 e/a.u.^3. Obtain converged charge/spin density and Kohn-Sham eigenvalues.
description: The DFT runs produce the ground-state electronic structure from which the scored magnetic moments and LDOS are derived.

title: Extract layer magnetic moments
action: From the self-consistent spin density, compute the magnetic moment inside each muffin-tin sphere for every atomic layer in all four slab systems. Save the results as magnetic_moments.csv.
description: Must contain the magnetic moment per layer, matching the paper's Table I layout.
output_schema: Columns: system (string, one of MnAs_MnTerm, MnAs_AsTerm, MnSb_MnTerm, MnSb_SbTerm), layer_label (string, e.g., Mn(S), Mn(S-2),..., X(S) etc.), magnetic_moment_muB (float). One row per atom layer per system.

title: Compute center-layer Mn LDOS
action: Compute the spin-polarized layer-projected density of states for the center Mn atom (Mn(C)) in the Mn-terminated MnAs and MnSb slabs. Output the total DOS for majority and minority spins on a fine energy grid. Save as center_ldos.csv.
description: LDOS data for the center Mn layer provides the primary evidence for the hybridization claim (stronger Mn-d – As-p hybridization in MnAs leading to more separated peaks).
output_schema: Columns: system (one of MnAs_MnTerm, MnSb_MnTerm), energy_eV (float, relative to Fermi level), spin (string: majority or minority), dos_total (float, total DOS in states/eV). Energy range from -6 eV to +4 eV with spacing ≤0.01 eV.
